[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for finding a reliable tailor include:

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Check with local dry cleaners for alteration services.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Use TaskRabbit for local taskers who can help with alterations.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Before choosing a tailor, check reviews, their experience, and ask about their repair process.  
[PREFERENCE] User is also wondering about the cost to repair jeans and whether it is usually a flat fee or depends on the complexity of the repair.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The cost of repairing jeans can vary based on the type of repair, complexity, location, and tailor's expertise.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] General estimates for common denim repairs:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Simple Repairs: Hemming or small tears: $10-$20  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Moderate Repairs: Medium-sized tears: $20-$40  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Complex Repairs: Large tears: $40-$60 or more  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Re-weaving or re-knitting: $50-$100 or more  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Complete rebuilding of a section: $100-$200 or more  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Some tailors may charge a flat fee, while others may charge an hourly rate of $20-$50.
